feeds.title: Healthcare Finance
feeds.description: Healthcare Finance is the leading news source for developments in the healthcare finance industry. Through its highly integrated platform, its team of award-winning editors delivers breaking news, in-depth reporting, analysis, and best practices around compelling topics such as capital investments, reimbursements, quality and safety, physician relations, billing collections, and data integrity, and how they affect both providers and payers alike.

feeds.title: New Rhein Healthcare Investors
feeds.description: New Rhein applies a private equity business model to life sciences venture capital investing, focusing on assets with proven clinical safety and efficacy applied in new ways (i.e. new delivery forms, new indications). Our goal is to develop products that deliver compelling health benefits to patients and compelling economic value to payors.
